content.text: Oe Cathut, ka phuenangnae dawk, ka lawk na thai pouh haw.
Ka tarannaw ka takinae koehoi ka hringnae na khetyawt lawih.
Tamikathoutnaw e kâdeikâpannae koehoi thoseh,
Payonnae kasaknaw kamkhuengnae koehoi thoseh, na ngue haw.
Ahnimouh ni amamae lai hah,
tahloi patetlah a hran sak awh.
Yonnae ka tawn hoeh e tami hah arulahoi ka hanelah,
lawkthoeumkha pala hoi a nue awh teh,
takinae tawn laipalah vaitalahoi ouk a ka awh.
Hawihoehnae dawk buet touh hoi buet touh a kâhroecoe awh.
Tangkhek patung hanelah a kâpan awh teh,
apinimouh na hmu han vah ouk ati awh.
Hawihoehnae hah ma hanelah a pâphue awh.
Ngit a pâphue awh.
Lungthin thung lengkaleng a pouknae teh a dungpoung.
Ahnimouh teh Cathut ni pala hoi a ka vaiteh,
pouk laipalah hmâ a ca awh han.
A dei awh e lawk dawk letlang a rawp sak vaiteh,
ka hmawt e pueng ni a yawng takhai awh han.
Tami pueng ni taket vaiteh,
Cathut ni a sak e doeh tie a pâpho awh han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, hmantang a sak awh e hah a pouk awh han.
Tamikalan teh BAWIPA dawk konawm vaiteh,
ama hah a kâuep han.
A lungthin kalan e pueng ni a pholen awh han.
